benchmark: In-loop PPO sample-preparation stage profile and matched full PPO replay
finding: Exact in-loop attribution identifies record loading/parse/validation (48.4%) as the largest preparation stage, followed by transition extraction (22.3%) and model-input construction (15.4%). Standalone full-reader timing (26.89 s) did not reproduce the 78.51 s in-loop load bucket. All 28 numeric metrics and all 82 checkpoint tensors match Round447 exactly. The PPO-only replay excludes rollout generation; complete iteration rate remains 16.49 games/s from Round430.
next_speedup_opportunities: Profile seek/read, JSON decoding, strict validation, allocation, and garbage collection separately inside representative full training chunks.
Reduce decoded-row object lifetime or stream compact transition arrays while preserving validation and exact sample parity.
Batch transition extraction and model-input construction over contiguous arrays; retain perspective safety and exact input/transition parity gates.
Test parallel prefetch/decode only after measuring CPU, storage, memory bandwidth, GPU contention, and peak RSS.
Measure aggregation and optimizer time independently before optimizing them.
limitations: Single instrumented full PPO replay; timing stages can perturb one another. Stage timers leave 8.74 s (5.4%) unattributed. No rollouts or strength evaluation were run.
